text_block_list.text:
The Fan Appreciation Festival. Fans packed 
into Tracen Academy just to catch a 
glimpse of this spring's star.

Oguri Cap. Mejiro McQueen. And Mejiro Ryan 
was among them as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, during this talk show... I'm 
going to try and speak my mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I don't know how they'll take it, but I 
want to show them the real, honest me!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes!

Give her a push on the back and send her 
off. Let's let her do as she pleases.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My goal for this spring? Why, that's 
already decided, of course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To become the heroine of Kyoto's Grand 
Swan. In other words—conquering the Spring 
Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is the destiny of the Mejiros, after 
all. May I ask for everyone's support?

As expected... Mejiro McQueen stands out 
tremendously. On the other hand...

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: What are your goals, Mejiro Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um, my goal is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We just have to do our best and figure it 
out!!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: S-Somehow...
It's a rather clumsy start, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I know. I'm still nowhere near the level 
of those called stars...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I can't say cool things like McQueen 
does...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“B-But doesn't it frustrate you?! Always 
being stuck in the shadows like this.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Because it's just too sad if those who 
work hard and steadily never get to be the 
protagonist.

—The atmosphere in the room shifted, and 
everyone began listening.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I want to believe that even someone like 
me can be noticed if I just try my best...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I want to show that even someone plain and 
ordinary can blossom if they try their 
hardest!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I wasn't great with people 
expecting things from me. Because I 
couldn't handle the pressure. But now—!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Please believe in me! Because of who I am, 
please expect great things from me!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"To answer everyone's feelings, I'll put 
on a race even hotter than the star 
Umamusume!!"

Mejiro Ryan's words, filled with resolute 
determination, were deeply engraved into 
the fans' hearts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're awake, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Knowing her, she was probably whining 
about how she could never be charismatic 
anyway, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Phew, such low self-esteem. As always, 
that girl truly doesn't understand her own 
worth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There was only one thing she lacked. The 
resolve to carry the weight of 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
When soul breathes into exceptional 
talent, and unwavering resolve is 
found—you have nothing less than a 
magnificent star.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, stars... the ones shining 
brightest from the start are not 
necessarily the best, you know."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There are stars that shine brighter as 
they gather the hopes of the people. That 
girl is the Joan of Arc of the Umamusume 
world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for your hard work! I 
think I spoke much better than I expected!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um, how was it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

Mejiro Ryan begins to show glimpses of 
stardom. A faint glimmer of blooming 
potential...

Then let's foster it into something even 
greater. First, aiming for the spring 
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: Um, Ryan-chan.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-chan was saying something about not 
being the main character, but you've 
always been famous, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Eeeek, really?! When? Where?!

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
Ever since she was a kid, the hardcore 
fans have been buzzing about how fast 
she'd run.

text_block_list.name: Man B
Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, they're here! Someone who 
acknowledges me, even just a little!

There were more people cheering for me 
than I thought. It seems some fans really 
fell in love with this build of mine.

"Then all the more reason to meet those 
expectations. First up is the upcoming 
spring Tenno Sho!"
